judgment_primitives.description: Restate the claim in a form the current evidence can actually answer, or narrow it to the discriminating question.
judgment_primitives.repair_prompt: Rewrite the claim so the evidence on the table could actually prove or disconfirm it.
judgment_primitives.title: Problem Reformulation & Reduction

judgment_primitives.description: Broaden or relax the category boundary so the argument is not winning by definition or by an overly local frame.
judgment_primitives.repair_prompt: Move up one level and state the broader category the argument must survive.
judgment_primitives.title: Generalization & Abstraction

judgment_primitives.description: Split the claim into separable components, test each one directly, then rebuild only what survives.
judgment_primitives.repair_prompt: Name the subclaims explicitly, test them one by one, then reassemble the surviving structure.
judgment_primitives.title: Decomposition & Recomposition

judgment_primitives.description: Show how a local result scales, transports, or aggregates before claiming the global conclusion.
judgment_primitives.plain_label: Rebuild the whole from local support
judgment_primitives.repair_prompt: State what is locally established, then identify the explicit gluing or scaling step needed for the global claim.
judgment_primitives.title: Local-to-Global Assembly

judgment_primitives.description: Replace a fragile proxy with the measurement, invariant, or comparison class that the argument actually needs.
judgment_primitives.plain_label: Define the invariant or decision rule
judgment_primitives.repair_prompt: Name the invariant, metric, or canonical representative that would make the argument robust to relabeling or proxy drift.
judgment_primitives.title: Canonical Form & Invariance

judgment_primitives.description: Move the argument into a different representation where the core issue becomes measurable, comparable, or testable.
judgment_primitives.plain_label: Translate the claim into a tractable frame
judgment_primitives.repair_prompt: Translate the problem into a different frame where the same structure can be checked more directly.
judgment_primitives.title: Cross-Domain Translation

non_primitive_runtime_concepts.description: Decision that the current framing is wrong and that the search should reframe rather than continue local basin search. This is a runtime decision heuristic, not a product repair primitive.
non_primitive_runtime_concepts.title: Topological Pivot

non_primitive_runtime_concepts.description: Tactical mutator-prompt module such as coordinate compression or category switch. Useful as lineage, but not exported as the primary product vocabulary.
non_primitive_runtime_concepts.title: Pivot Heuristic Module

non_primitive_runtime_concepts.description: Mathematical transform used inside fitting or representation change. These are lower-scale apparatus elements, not user-facing judgment primitives.
non_primitive_runtime_concepts.title: Fit-Time Transform

role_boundary.non_primitive_runtime_concepts: Kernel or runtime concepts that should not be collapsed into the product primitive vocabulary.
role_boundary.product_primitives: User-facing repair moves for ClearJudgment and Mini-ZTARE.
role_boundary.warning: Fractal lineage does not imply identity. Cross-scale aliases are for translation and audit, not for merging all vocabularies.
